summary: Frontend-only regression + 2 new features on /app/sod. SodContext refactor dropped nothing — every card renders with live data (no undefined/blank). All 4 KPI StatCards (28/40/3/72), Scorecard, Auto-Rem, Governance Digest Schedule, Simulator, Rule Library, and Conflicts Table load cleanly. New Ticket Deep-Link modal fetches CHG100577 and renders all 6 stages, meta chips, and duration footer; closes cleanly. New 'Assigned to me' lens shows count (1) and keeps Finance visible when ON (only pinned area owned by admin). Filter (72→29 rows on Critical), Mitigate dialog, Simulator (APPROVE decision), Rule Library dialog, watchlist add/unpin, and Alert toggle all fire correctly.

issues: Minor hydration warning in console: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' inside SodWatchlist line 159 — comes from stagewise/dev instrumentation injecting <span> into <option>. Not a runtime bug (option text renders fine) but produces a React hydration warning. Consider removing the dynamic wrapper for option children.

critical_code_review_comments: Hydration warning from SodWatchlist.jsx:159 — <option> receives a <span> child via dev x-* instrumentation. Cosmetic only, but noisy in production console.
